online-whiteboard.formula:
The whiteboard is a drawing tool, not a calculator — there is no formula.
Strokes are rendered as paths on an HTML canvas at your device's pixel density, so lines stay crisp on high-resolution screens.
howTo: Choose the pen tool, pick a colour, and set a brush size that suits your sketch.
Press and drag on the board to draw. Use the line, rectangle, or circle tools for neat shapes.
Pick the eraser to rub out mistakes, or use Undo to step back through recent strokes.
Use Clear board to wipe everything and start fresh.
Click Download PNG to save your finished drawing as an image file.
keyFacts: Freehand pen, eraser, line, rectangle, and circle tools cover most quick-sketch needs.
Brush size adjusts from 1 to 50 pixels; the pen colour can be any value you pick.
Undo keeps your last 20 strokes, so mistakes are never permanent.
The board is touch-friendly — draw with a finger or stylus on phones and tablets.
Export is a standard PNG file, ready to share, print, or paste into documents.
Your drawing exists only in the page. Refreshing the tab clears the board.

online-whiteboard.quickAnswer: JaurTools Whiteboard is a free digital drawing board that lives in your browser. Pick a pen colour and brush size, sketch with your mouse or finger, add lines, rectangles and circles, erase mistakes, undo up to 20 strokes, and download the finished board as a PNG image. Nothing is uploaded — your drawing never leaves your device.
online-whiteboard.tagline: Sketch and annotate freely — export when you're done.
online-whiteboard.workedExample:
Sketching a quick flowchart:
1. Select the rectangle tool and draw three boxes for Start, Process, and End.
2. Switch to the line tool and connect the boxes.
3. Pick the pen, choose a dark colour, and label each box.
4. Fix a wobbly line with the eraser or Undo.
5. Click Download PNG and share the flowchart in your team chat.
